description:
Vision Board App and Affirmation App that turn your goals into reality. Vision Board ++ combines personalized vision boards, inspiring movies with spoken affirmations, and home screen widgets into a daily visualization practice you'll actually stick with.

Successful athletes, artists, and entrepreneurs use visualization and affirmations as part of their success strategies. This vision board app brings both together in one powerful experience on your iPhone or iPad. Vision Board ++ is more than a vision board app — it's the daily ritual that keeps your future in focus.

Uplifting vision boards and daily affirmations help rewire your thinking and replace negative patterns with positive ones. As a self-help and manifestation tool, this vision board app and affirmation app empowers you to affirm your dreams every day.

Vision Board ++ Includes
• Make vision boards or mood boards with different grids
• Easily add photos, affirmations or quotes
• Photo gallery with millions of inspirational photos
• Make custom affirmations or quotes
• Choose between many different voices
• Enter any wish and generate personalized affirmations powered by AI
• Practice your affirmations with personalized sessions
• Inspirational music for your affirmation sessions
• Record affirmations in your voice
• Inspirational music for your vision board Magic Movies
• Thousands of affirmations from different categories
• Personalize the background of your vision boards and affirmations
• Reminders for vision boards and affirmations
• Easily move or duplicate images to other vision boards
• Dark and Light mode
• Gratitude Journal
• Widget
• Lock Screen Widget
• iCloud Sync

With this vision board app, you can build a personalized vision board — also known as a dream board or mind movie — that represents your goals and aspirations. Choose from your own photos, millions of Unsplash images, or pair them with affirmations and inspiring music for a vision board video that brings your dreams to life.

With the Vision Board ++ membership, you support the development of Vision Board ++ and receive unique features to increase your personal motivation:

• Full access to all features
• Feel better with vision boards, mood boards, affirmations, and your journal
• Record unlimited affirmations in your voice
• Many different voices, layouts, music
• Unlimited AI Affirmations
• Unlock thousands of affirmations for any situation
• Unlock Magic Movies with inspiring music or use Apple Music
• Custom colors and backgrounds
• Feel inspired and motivated every day
• iCloud Sync

Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel or manage your free trial's auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase. The cancellation will take effect 24 hours after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
Please note: Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a plus subscription during the free trial period.

If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the app, please do not hesitate to contact us and send an email to support@hero21.app. We have put a lot of time and love into our app and look forward to receiving your positive feedback.
